name_reason: Matches naming convention data_fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>: domain=animation, descriptor=ani_decoder_frame_dispatch_table. Descriptor accurately reflects both the data type (dispatch table = function-pointer array) and purpose (ANI.DAT frame-byte opcode dispatch). No Ghidra address residue. The '10' implicit in the array dimension is the real entry count (verified by memory layout), not address residue.
purpose: ANI.DAT frame-byte-stream opcode dispatch table: flat array of 10 zero-arg void function pointers, indexed by the opcode byte read from the frame stream, selecting one chunk-decoder handler per byte.
logic_summary: Sole reader fd2_ani_decoder_decode_frame_bytes (@0x36C9E) walks the frame byte stream with LODSB (AL=opcode), zero-extends, SHL AX,2 (*4 pointer stride), MOVZX EBX,AX, then CALL dword ptr [EBX+0x5276A] at 0x36CBC -- the 'index*4 then CALL [base+index*4]' addressing proves a flat array of 4-byte function pointers indexed by the opcode byte. Each handler is a zero-argument void routine operating on shared globals (the ANI stream cursor ESI plus the width/dst/src triple set by fd2_ani_decoder_set_target_buffer @0x36C7D), so element type is void(*)(void).
datatype: void (*[10])(void)  (10 x 4-byte function pointers, 40 bytes total)
element_semantics: Each element is a code* (4-byte function pointer) to an ANI chunk-decoder handler, indexed by opcode byte. Verified entries in address order: [0] 0x36AE7 fd2_ani_decoder_chunk_palette_fill_byte; [1] 0x36B01 fd2_ani_decoder_chunk_palette_load_literal; [2] 0x36B0F fd2_ani_decoder_chunk_palette_load_rle; [3] 0x36B51 fd2_ani_decoder_chunk_palette_load_run_pairs; [4] 0x36B8A fd2_ani_decoder_chunk_row_fill_byte; [5] 0x36BB2 fd2_ani_decoder_chunk_row_copy_literal; [6] 0x36BCE fd2_ani_decoder_chunk_row_decode_rle; [7] 0x36C13 fd2_ani_decoder_chunk_sparse_set_byte; [8] 0x36C2C fd2_ani_decoder_chunk_sparse_set_run_byte; [9] 0x36C56 fd2_ani_decoder_chunk_sparse_copy_literal.
notes: All home-file comment facts (lines 439-491 of anitab.c) verified against Ghidra: (1) memory read of 48 bytes @0x5276A shows 10 LE pointers {0x36AE7,0x36B01,0x36B0F,0x36B51,0x36B8A,0x36BB2,0x36BCE,0x36C13,0x36C2C,0x36C56} followed by 4 zero bytes then the 'Stack Overflow!' literal -- confirms exactly 10 entries (40 bytes). (2) get_xrefs_to: single DATA xref from 0x36CBC in fd2_ani_decoder_decode_frame_bytes, no writers -> const. (3) disasm of reader confirms SUB AH,AH; SHL AX,2; MOVZX EBX,AX; CALL [EBX+0x5276A] dispatch. (4) all 10 handler addresses resolve to exactly the named functions listed in the comment, in order. (5) datatype in Ghidra = pointer[10] len=40, symbol name matches. Comment is a precise conclusion (not a process log) so kept verbatim; name compliant so kept. Ghidra has NO PLATE_COMMENT but a detailed and consistent PRE_COMMENT describing the same 10 targets + reader + animation domain; it is accurate and not contradictory/stale/blank, so left untouched per the 'consistent => do not modify plate' rule (ghidra_plate_action=none).
